description: Fetch one guide by slug. Most guides come back whole in this one call. A long guide returns its summary, section headings and short checked FAQ answers instead; then pass section (one of the headings) for that section's text, or full: true for the whole guide.

full.description: Return the whole guide's markdown (long; prefer section).

section.description: A heading from the guide's sections, to return just that section.

name: dp_get_guide
title: Get one guide
